name: "Sloppy Joe" Beef Bowl with Sweet Potatoes, Cabbage & Pickled Onion

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, honey, and salt in a medium bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sweet potatoes
1 ½ small heads red cabbage
1 ½ jalapeño peppers

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, then drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp parsley flakes
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sweet potato is fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, and spices in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
apple cider vinegar
honey
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
salt
black pepper
¼ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve each cabbage lengthwise, cut out the core, and slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing, toss to coat, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, thinly slice jalapeño peppers into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Once the skillet is hot, add beef and salt; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
Add water, ketchup, Dijon, vinegar, and spices to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened slightly, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup ketchup
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide sweet potatoes, cabbage, and beef between bowls. Top with jalapeños and pickled onions. Enjoy!
